title: Fulbright-Garcia Robles Graduate Degree Program (COMEXUS, Mexico)
official_source: Comision Mexico-Estados Unidos para el Intercambio Educativo y Cultural (COMEXUS), with the Fulbright Program
duration: Up to 2 academic years for a master's degree and up to 3 academic years for a PhD, with the first academic year funded and continuation subject to performance and budget availability
description: The COMEXUS Fulbright-Garcia Robles Graduate Degree Program funds US candidates to complete a master's or PhD degree at a qualified Mexican academic institution. COMEXUS will fund up to two academic years for a master's and up to three academic years for a PhD, with an initial academic year of funding and continuation subject to academic performance and availability of funds. Financial support comprises monthly maintenance, one round-trip international air ticket for the grantee, a Fulbright medical benefit plan, COMEXUS assistance with visa paperwork, and up to 50,000 pesos per academic year

title: CSHL School of Biological Sciences Ph.D. Program (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory)
official_source: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory, School of Biological Sciences
program_type: Research institute doctoral programme with automatic full funding
duration: Approximately five years from matriculation to PhD; the average time to degree is reported as 5.19 years
description: The Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory School of Biological Sciences admits approximately nine students per entering class from backgrounds across the biological sciences and beyond, and funds its students from an endowment so that the School pays all tuition costs and associated study fees and provides a stipend currently $50,000 per year.

title: Posse Foundation Scholarship
duration: Four years of undergraduate study at a Posse partner college or university
description: The Posse Foundation awards a full-tuition scholarship to each Posse Scholar to attend one of its partner colleges or universities in the United States. Students cannot apply directly: they must be nominated by their high school or a community-based organisation in one of Posse's more than 20 recruitment cities, and they take part in Posse's Dynamic Assessment Process nomination programme. Posse describes the scholarship as neither a minority nor a need-based award, and states that it is open to students of all backgrounds. title: Beca para estudiantes en situación de discapacidad
official_source: Ministerio de Educación de Chile (Mineduc), published on ChileAtiende, the official portal of the Government of Chile
duration: Annual, tied to the Chilean academic year; the benefit is assigned per admission cycle (admisión) and renewed on the same basis as the underlying scholarship.
description: Economic support from the Ministerio de Educación for students in a situation of disability with meritorious academic performance (secondary-school average of 5.0 or above), financing all or part of the annual tuition of a regular degree at an institution accredited as at 31 December 2026. It is delivered as reserved places (cupos) of the Beca Bicentenario, Beca Juan Gómez Millas and Beca Nuevo Milenio - 750 places in total - so the amount depends on the type of institution and degree.

title: Beca de Reparación Valech
official_source: Ministerio de Educación de Chile (Mineduc), published on ChileAtiende, the official portal of the Government of Chile
duration: Annual, tied to the Chilean academic year and to the admission cycle in which the benefit is assigned.
description: A reparations benefit created by Ley N° 19.992 for people named in the Informe de la Comisión Valech, funding the enrolment fee and the annual tuition of an undergraduate degree with official Mineduc recognition. If the named person does not use the benefit, it may be transferred to a child or grandchild, with coverage that depends on the beneficiary type and the type of institution.

title: Beca para hijas e hijos de profesionales de la educación
official_source: Ministerio de Educación de Chile (Mineduc), published on ChileAtiende, the official portal of the Government of Chile
duration: Annual, tied to the Chilean academic year and to the admission cycle in which the benefit is assigned; renewals are handled in the same annual process.

title: Beca Nuevo Milenio
official_source: Ministerio de Educación de Chile (Mineduc), published on ChileAtiende, the official portal of the Government of Chile
duration: Annual, tied to the Chilean academic year and to the admission cycle in which the benefit is assigned; continuing students must pass 60% of first-year subjects to reach second year and 70% of second-year subjects to reach third year.
